title: Three-bedroom terraced house in North London
summary: A three-bedroom terraced house for sale in North London at £500,000. Presented with supplied existing views and clearly labelled proposed interior concepts.

children.text: A three-bedroom terraced house in North London, offered for sale through Haus of Estate at an asking price of £500,000. Haus has confirmed this is a ready property. The supplied imagery includes existing views and a separate interior design proposal.

The proposed interiors explore ideas for the living and dining space, kitchen and bathroom areas. AI-assisted visuals illustrate possible furnishing, lighting and finishes; they do not show completed renovation works or confirm what is included in the sale.

Images labelled BEFORE show the existing views supplied with the proposal. Images labelled AFTER show proposed design concepts. Current condition, measurements and any proposed works must be verified separately.

verification.notes: Private draft prepared 6 October 2026; updated 11 October 2026 using Sonia / Haus WhatsApp messages dated 7 October 2026, supplied by Surya in this chat. Sonia explicitly confirms GBP 500,000 sale price, three bedrooms, terraced property and ready property. Ready describes the property status, not completion of the illustrated renovations, vacant possession or verified current stock. Public location policy: no road name or postcode; retain broad North London, London only. Hackney appeared in Surya's question and is not independently confirmed in Sonia's reply. Original Haus Marketing email 2 October 2026, message 1a0fc0570afd32f4, confirms North London (subject), three bedrooms and sale intent. Forwarded 30 September proposal, message 1a0f2c329e8d0f2b, identifies AI-assisted initial concepts; AFTER is proposed appearance, not completed works. Five source boards visually inspected and SHA256-verified. The 7 October 20:53 BST image email (1a117edfd32c68e9) contains concept images, not a floor plan; Sonia said she would share a plan, but it has not been inspected. Bathroom/reception counts, built-up and plot measurements, tenure/lease costs, council tax, EPC, occupancy and available inventory remain unconfirmed. Current-condition accuracy, image approval and inclusion of any works remain unverified. No road name, postcode, measured plan, precise map pin or invented dimensions. Preserve draft identity and slug. Do not import or publish without further instruction.
